function_signature: def ct_select(cond: int, a: int, b: int) -> int
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (10 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: if / ternary / secret-dependent loops are banned
a cond other than 0/1 raises ValueError
source: 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.5 §2; OpenSSL constant_time.h; Coda Hale 2009 *A Lesson in Timing Attacks*
author: Zhou Wenquan
